t_advice_summary_textbox.text: gnomes will appear in pairs, each color guide me to a forest , depends of the color it might guide me to the bright or the dark forest. The number in the forests change. My goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible. there are two colors of baskets red and yellow

vb_textbox.text: Hi! There are some important informations for you to play this game:1. Gnomes will always appear in fixed pairs,2. Each gnome within a pair will lead you to a different forest, bright and dark3. Orange, green, red and blue will lead you to the bright forest with red basket4. Brown, pink, yellow and purple take you to the dark forest with yellow basket5. Your goal is to reach the forest that currently has the most mushrooms6. Keep the track of the number of mushrooms you can harvest on each forest on each round, it suggest you which forest have more mushrooms on each roundGood luck!
